connector.name: MCP Ip2whois
connector.registryDescription: WHOIS domain MCP server that query the WHOIS information using IP2WHOIS API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-ip2whois. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ip2whois account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
